en: Black‑and‑white photo postcard showing a large turn‑of‑the‑century villa with a tiled roof and multiple dormers. The facade features a two‑story semicircular portico with columns, balconies with scalloped awnings, and many windows. It sits in a landscaped garden with a palm, curved gravel drive, shrubs, and a white curved bench. No caption on the front. The divided back bears a stamp reading "Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont" and handwritten inventory numbers.
